verdict.rationale: First-party pricing docs say you can self-host free with Docker, and a community user shows the official image is pulled with `docker pull mintplexlabs/anythingllm`. Independent users praise the single-install desktop package and report a working chat in under 5 minutes, even on a standard office PC. Missing for 10: a first-party documented install/run command and setup walkthrough in the pack, plus evidence of a smooth Linux path (one user needed a manual chrome-sandbox permission fix; the docker pull timeout reported looks like a client network issue, not a product failure).
